Priya (new-hire): Hey team — first week! Quick: where's the canonical Notion spot for onboarding templates (RFC, runbook) and who approves duplicate/edit access? Some pages show view-only for me.

Marta (People Ops): Welcome Priya :tada: Canonical templates are under Notion > Company Home > Templates > Team Templates and Eng > Onboarding. If pages are view-only, click Request access or DM me your work email and I can add you to Engineering Editors.

sam_docs: Hi! If you hit view-only use the Request access flow and include a one-line reason like "ramp + need RFC copy". That creates a docs ticket. Ping @sam_docs in the ticket and I can expedite. Note: a few templates are locked (duplication restricted) to keep canonical copies clean.

tyler_eng: Also, infra/runbook pages under Team Restricted need team membership. If you need short-term edit/view for ramping, say which page and how long and we'll grant temporary access.

Priya (new-hire): Thanks — priya@redwood.com. I just want to duplicate RFC into my private workspace first and add a link to my ramp notes. Any file naming convs for ramps?

Marta (People Ops): Great — we recommend "Last, First — Ramp" for personal ramps (helps sorting). For shared ramps: "Last, First — Ramp (Team)" and place under Eng > Ramps with a one-line summary at the top.

sam_docs: Ticket created DR-15802 for priya@redwood.com (requested by Marta). Link: https://notion.company/requests/DR-15802

docs-bot: docs-requests  Access granted; priya@redwood.com added to Engineering Editors. Ticket DR-15802 closed.

Priya (new-hire): Invite came through — copying RFC now. Thanks everyone :smile:
